label: Glass 3D (WebGL)
description: George's cake-ascent animation re-staged in WebGL with the Data Core glass: the data point, rings drawing on, rays to the data sources and the data frame, the tilt to 3D, glass tiers rising one by one with swags and a dotted grid, the star and the frosting rain on a close-up, the pull back to the whole cake on its stand with data drips, and a slow dissolve back to the data point (30 s loop). Hero only for now; the other slots keep the original PNGs. Tuner: press T.
